messages.text: Which critical spares run out before the supplier recovers?

answer.text:
Two critical spares run out before their closed sole supplier is due to recover: the haul truck wheel assembly runs out about 20 days early and the ship loader drive motor about 36 days early.



**1. Haul truck wheel assembly (BKS-400), SAP material MZ-RM-S400-04**
- **Stock:** 40.2 days of cover from today, so it runs out on 1 December 2026.
- **Supplier:** Kwinana OTR Wheel Works (USSU-VSF84) has its plant closed for 60 days and is due back on 21 December 2026.
- **Gap:** about 19.8 days with no supply.
- **Exposure:** all 40 haul trucks use this part, so this is the more urgent case. It hits first and is a direct risk to tonnes hauled in Q2 FY2027.

**2. Ship loader drive motor 200 kW, SAP material MZ-SP-A101**
- **Stock:** 144 days of cover, so it runs out on 15 March 2027.
- **Supplier:** Pilbara Electric Motors (SAP supplier 0017300001) has its plant closed for 180 days and is due back on 20 April 2027.
- **Gap:** about 36 days with no supply.
- **Exposure:** one asset, ship loader SL-01. It is the only one, so a failure would stop shipments at the port.

The data is simulated for a fictional operator, built on real SAP BDC IDs. Each row is MIXED: stock and cover are SAP stand-in data, and the supplier and alert records come from SAP-style sources.

**Next step:** Expedite or find another source for the BKS-400 wheels before 1 December. I can run the supply what-if for the wheel plant case at the 90 audit-score bar to see whether any other supplier can qualify, and do the same for the motor plant case after that.

**Sources**
- **SAP / SAP stand-in:** materials MZ-RM-S400-04 and MZ-SP-A101; suppliers USSU-VSF84 and 0017300001; supplier alerts ALR-2026-1022-01 and ALR-2026-1022-02; spares cover outlook.
- **Operational systems:** the fleet assets that use each part (40 haul trucks and SL-01).
